tasks.title: TDD: Port preflight display
tasks.description:
Add preflight display functions to `src/commands/plan.ts` and tests in `test/commands/plan.test.ts`.

Port the preflight section from `lib/ralph_plan.sh` (lines ~64-113) that shows:
- Project name banner (e.g., `\n  Project: my-project\n`)
- Existing planning notes status (exists / not found, with path)
- Completed task count from `tasks.completed.json`
- Current `tasks.json` summary: status counts (e.g., `2 pending, 1 complete`) + per-task listing with status icons (`✓ ○ ▶ ✗`)

Reuse the `STATUS_ICONS` pattern from `src/commands/status.ts`. Extract as pure functions that take data and return formatted strings (or print to console). Use `console.log` spying in tests (same pattern as `test/commands/status.test.ts`).

Use temp directories with fixture JSON files for testing.

tasks.title: TDD: Port planning prompt builder
tasks.description:
Add a `buildPlanningPrompt` pure function to `src/commands/plan.ts` with tests.

Port the planning system prompt from `lib/ralph_plan.sh`. The prompt includes:
- Project context (name, root, data dir)
- Briefing materials section: reads and embeds content from CLAUDE.md, README.md, package.json/Cargo.toml/Makefile, existing planning-notes.md, tasks.completed.json, IMPLEMENTATION.md — each wrapped in labeled sections, skipped if file doesn't exist
- Agent discovery section: if agents exist (from `discoverAgents()` in config.ts), list them with name, description, model
- Planning-notes.md format specification (what the output file should contain)
- Rules (write to planning-notes.md, no code changes, etc.)

The function should accept `{ projectName, projectRoot, dataDir, agents }` and return the prompt string. Read files inside the function using `fs.readFileSync` with existence checks.

Test that output contains expected section headers, embeds file contents when present, omits sections when files don't exist, includes agent list when agents are provided.

tasks.title: TDD: Port task generation prompt builder
tasks.description:
Add a `buildTaskGenPrompt` pure function to `src/commands/plan.ts` with tests.

Port the task generation system prompt from `lib/ralph_plan.sh`. The prompt includes:
- Project context (name, root, data dir, tasks file path)
- The full tasks.json schema embedded from `src/tasks-schema.json` (read via `fs.readFileSync`)
- Task structure guidelines (what each field means, how to scope tasks)
- Directory guidelines table (module work vs cross-module)
- Test command guidelines (prefer project test scripts over direct tool invocations, read package.json)
- Agent section (if agents discovered)
- Rules (never modify complete tasks, keep IDs unique, etc.)
- Git status (current branch, recent commits)

The function should accept `{ projectName, projectRoot, dataDir, agents, gitStatus }` and return the prompt string.

Test that output embeds the schema, contains guideline sections, includes agents when provided, omits agent section when empty.

tasks.title: TDD: Port planning and task generation session launchers
tasks.description:
Add `launchPlanningSession` and `launchTaskGeneration` functions to `src/commands/plan.ts` with tests.

Both functions spawn `claude` via `spawnSync` with `stdio: 'inherit'`:

**Planning session:**
```
spawnSync('claude', ['--append-system-prompt', planningPrompt, '--allowedTools', 'Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: projectRoot, env: { ...process.env, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: '' } })
```

**Task generation:**
```
spawnSync('claude', ['--append-system-prompt', taskGenPrompt, '--allowedTools', 'Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit', 'Read planning-notes.md and generate the task breakdown...'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: projectRoot, env: { ...process.env, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: '' } })
```

Both should:
- Clear `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the spawned env
- `cwd` to project root
- Fire narration/ntfy at session start and end (call `sendToNarrate`/`sendNtfy` from stream-filter.ts if enabled via config)
- Accept an injectable spawn function for testability (same pattern as `src/commands/summarize.ts`)

Test that spawn is called with correct args, env has empty API key, narration/ntfy are called at boundaries.

tasks.title: TDD: Port notes review loop
tasks.description:
Add a `reviewNotesLoop` function to `src/commands/plan.ts` with tests.

Use the shared menu helper from `src/menu.ts` to implement the notes review menu from `lib/ralph_plan.sh`.

Menu options:
- `[g]enerate` — proceed to task generation (exit menu, return signal to continue)
- `[e]dit` — open `planning-notes.md` in $EDITOR using `runEdit` from `src/commands/edit.ts`
- `[p]lan` — re-launch planning session (call `launchPlanningSession`)
- `[b]ack` — optional, only shown if there are existing notes. Returns to planning.
- `[q]uit` — exit the entire plan command

Before showing the menu, display the current planning notes content (read `planning-notes.md` and print it, or show 'No planning notes yet').

The function should accept dependencies (menu helper, edit function, launch function) as injectable params for testability.

Test: menu dispatches correctly, edit calls runEdit with correct path, plan re-launches session, generate signals exit with continue flag, quit signals exit with stop flag.

tasks.title: TDD: Port task review loop
tasks.description:
Add a `reviewTasksLoop` function to `src/commands/plan.ts` with tests.

Use the shared menu helper from `src/menu.ts` to implement the task review menu from `lib/ralph_plan.sh`.

Menu options:
- `[r]un` — delegate to `shellFallback('run', [])` from `src/commands/fallback.ts` (temporary until Phase 4 ports the run command)
- `[e]dit` — open `tasks.json` in $EDITOR using `runEdit` from `src/commands/edit.ts`
- `[v]iew` — show task summary (reuse preflight display functions from task #4)
- `[p]lan` — go back to planning phase (exit menu, return signal to restart)
- `[q]uit` — exit the entire plan command

Before showing the menu, display the current task summary.

The function should accept dependencies as injectable params for testability.

Test: menu dispatches correctly, run calls shellFallback, edit calls runEdit with tasks.json path, view shows summary, plan signals restart, quit signals exit.

tasks.title: Wire plan into Commander and remove from fallback
tasks.description:
Update `src/index.ts` to register `plan` as a native Commander command:

1. Remove `'plan'` from `SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS` array
2. Add a `program.command('plan').description('...').action(async () => { ... })` that calls the main `runPlan` function from `src/commands/plan.ts`
3. In `src/commands/fallback.ts`, remove `plan: 'ralph_plan.sh'` from `COMMAND_SCRIPT_MAP`
4. Verify `RALPH_FORCE_SHELL=1` still delegates everything to shell (this is handled by existing logic in index.ts — just confirm it still works)
5. Update `test/index.test.ts` and `test/commands/fallback.test.ts` to reflect the changes

The `runPlan` function should orchestrate the full flow: preflight → planning session → notes review loop → task generation → task review loop, with the loops allowing back-navigation between phases.

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile produces working binary
tasks.description:
Run `bun build --compile` (check package.json for the exact build script) and verify the compiled binary works:

1. Run the build command
2. Test `./ralph-bin plan --help` (or whatever the binary name is) doesn't crash
3. Test `./ralph-bin status` still works (regression check on previously ported commands)
4. Test `./ralph-bin logs` still works
5. If the build embeds `src/tasks-schema.json`, verify it's included (the prompt builder reads it via `fs.readFileSync` relative to `import.meta.dir` — this may need adjustment for compiled binaries)

If `import.meta.dir` doesn't resolve correctly in the compiled binary for reading `tasks-schema.json`, the schema content may need to be inlined as a string constant at build time or imported directly. Fix any issues found.

tasks.title: Fix healthCheck in ralph.json
tasks.description: The ralph.json healthCheck is set to `bun build` which fails because it has no entrypoint. Change it to `bun run build` so it uses the build script from package.json (`bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph`).
